parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Private domain scope. Provide a team private domain or custom domain. The public domain is not supported by streaming endpoints.

parameters.name: full
parameters.description: When true, returns the full message entity instead of the summary. The Mailinator API enforces a limit of 1 when `full=true`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of messages to return (1-99 unless `full=true`).

parameters.name: throttleInterval
parameters.description: Throttle interval to control the rate of streaming messages (e.g., `1s`, `5s`, `1m`).

parameters.name: delete
parameters.description: Minimum delay before the fetched message is scheduled for deletion (e.g., `1s`, `5m`, `1h`).
